prompt:
Return only one bare JSON object with exactly five keys: name, phone, email, company, country. Every value is a string or JSON null. No Markdown, prose, or extra keys.

COUNTRY PRECEDENCE: A supplied country line controls country. If the line is absent, blank, or a placeholder and the phone is international, country must be filled when the calling code uniquely identifies a country. Shared calling codes such as +1 and +7 leave country null. This is the only exception to the missing-value rule. An international phone always keeps its own calling code.

READ AND ASSIGN: Use only the contact block's label–value lines in the note. Recognize variant labels and colon, equals, or tab separators in any line order. Ignore surrounding notes and signatures. Trim every value and collapse whitespace runs to one space. Treat absent, empty, and whole-value placeholders (-, --, n/a, na, none, unknown, ?, null, TBD, any case) as missing. Reserve the country line for country. From other lines, assign by content first: @ means email; at least seven digits and only digits, spaces, or + - ( ) . / after removing leading tel: and a trailing extension means phone. Extensions are ext. N, ext N, xN, #N, or extension N (numeric N). Do not reuse rerouted values. For name and company use their labeled values unless the name line ends with a legal suffix but the company line does not; then swap before cleaning either.

COUNTRY AND PHONE:
- Supplied country: map English, Swedish, or German names and alpha-2 or alpha-3 codes case-insensitively to uppercase ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. Accept common aliases including UK/Great Britain → GB, Holland → NL, USA/U.S.A. → US, Türkiye → TR, Czech Republic → CZ.
- International phone: strip tel: and the extension and check whether it starts with + or 00, ignoring an opening parenthesis. Remove (0), then remove spaces, dashes, dots, slashes and parentheses; replace initial 00 with +. Keep the written calling code regardless of the country line. Resolve a missing country from that calling code as specified above.
- National phone: strip tel:, extension and formatting, remove one leading trunk 0 if present, and prepend + and the supplied country's calling code. Without a country, a national phone is null. A non-null phone is E.164: + followed only by digits.

OTHER FIELDS:
- Name: split Last, First at the first comma and reorder to First Last. Remove leading Dr, Mr, Mrs, Ms, Mx, or Prof, with or without a dot, ignoring case. Uppercase the first character and lowercase the rest of each space- or hyphen-separated part.
- Company: remove a trailing legal suffix and any optional preceding comma, trim, then uppercase the first character and lowercase the rest of each space-separated word. Use the same case-insensitive suffix list for removal and swap detection: AB, GmbH, AG, Ltd, Ltd., PLC, Inc, Inc., LLC, Corp, Corp., AS, ASA, Oy, Oyj, A/S, ApS, SA, SAS, B.V., N.V., S.p.A., Sp. z o.o., K.K., Pty Ltd, Ltda.
- Email: remove surrounding angle brackets and a leading mailto: prefix, then lowercase the entire address.

Preserve Unicode letters and diacritics through casing; never transliterate. Emit null for each remaining missing value. Do not guess or fill fields using notes, signatures, domains, or company suffixes.
